searches.name: Windows AD Snapshot Created By ADExplorer
searches.spl:
`sysmon` ((EventCode=1 OriginalFileName="AdExp") OR EventCode=11)
  | eval snapshot_file=if(EventCode=11 AND NOT match(TargetFilename, "(?i)\\\\SchCache\\\\[^\\\\]+\\.sch$"), TargetFilename, null())
  | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(OriginalFileName) as original_file_name values(Image) as process_path values(CommandLine) as process values(ParentImage) as parent_process_path values(User) as user values(snapshot_file) as snapshot_file
    BY Computer ProcessGuid
  | where original_file_name="AdExp" AND isnotnull(snapshot_file)
  | rename Computer as dest, ProcessGuid as process_guid
  | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
  | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
  | `windows_ad_snapshot_created_by_adexplorer_filter`

searches.name: Windows Sysinternals ADExplorer Execution
searches.spl:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly`
  count min(_time) as firstTime
        max(_time) as lastTime

from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where

(Processes.process_name IN ("ADExplorer.exe", "ADExplorer64.exe", "ADExplorer64a.exe", "ADExp.exe") OR Processes.original_file_name="AdExp")

by Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec
   Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path
   Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id
   Processes.process_integrity_level Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user Processes.user_id
   Processes.vendor_product

| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval renamed=if(match(process_name, "(?i)^ADExp(lorer)?(64a?)?\\.exe$"), "no", "yes")
| eval snapshot_cli=if(like(lower(process), "%snapshot%"), "yes", "no")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `windows_sysinternals_adexplorer_execution_filter`

searches.name: Comparison: Sigma-style process logic (ADExplorer image name + "snapshot" argument)
searches.note: Image-name and command-line logic, as in the public Sigma rules. It misses the renamed copy and the GUI menu snapshot.
searches.spl:
`sysmon` EventCode=1 process_name IN ("ADExplorer.exe", "ADExplorer64.exe", "ADExp.exe", "ADExplorer64a.exe") process="*snapshot*"
| table _time process_name process

searches.name: Comparison: Sigma-style file logic (ADExplorer image writes a .dat file)
searches.note: It misses the renamed copy and the .tmp snapshot.
searches.spl:
`sysmon` EventCode=11 process_name IN ("ADExplorer.exe", "ADExplorer64.exe", "ADExp.exe", "ADExplorer64a.exe") TargetFilename="*.dat"
| table _time process_name TargetFilename
